Local classical definition imports only this convention and does not import a polynomial bit-time bound. Multitape definition has fixed finite alphabet, k reads/writes/moves per transition.

Actual QC register definition and computational-basis proof give positive register dimension and zero-qubit C; product-basis lemma proves finite orthonormal tensor bases including empty list. Dirac definition uses root-linear-first outer map v -> <v,u>u. Unit-vector-projector proof explicitly gives self-adjointness, quadratic positivity and trace one by finite Parseval.

Actual syntax requires distinct ordered wires, disjoint layers and finite chronology. Local embedding proof conjugates U tensor I by explicit basis permutation; disjoint-layer proof compares basis coefficients. Denotation proof composes chronological layers in reverse matrix order and proves unitarity, including empty circuit.

Actual coherent oracle and XOR theorem use total functions on the full address domain; applying XOR twice and permuting the full orthonormal product basis prove unitarity/involution without injectivity. Control definition and full verification give control-first diag(I,U) by block norm and inverse; inverse definition reverses chronology and separately requires access/charge.

QC elementary resources counts explicit gate occurrences/layers/all wires; QC14 cost model separately defines minimum shared-wire-respecting depth. Actual QC promise model now initializes auxiliary wires to zero without clean-restoration assertion; ordered output wires and predicate remain explicit. QA finite branch definition extends the base unitary model using same-register finite instruments; quantum algorithm explicitly declares nonuniformity unless full-list condition supplied.

Instrument definition has finite nonempty observed outcomes, CP maps and sum-of-traces preservation on every operator. Actual CP definition includes r=1 under canonical unitary identification. Instrument normalization proof uses exactly positivity and nonnegative spectral diagonal to obtain nonnegative traces, then trace preservation. Conditional-state proof divides by strictly positive real branch probability and normalizes trace; explicit self-adjointness preservation is omitted (finding below).

Root nonnegative definition requires self-adjointness plus quadratic positivity. Actual adjoint-algebra proof gives conjugate scalar and product rules; finite isometry equivalence gives Udagger U=I; cyclic trace proof expands finite double sums. These are exactly the directions used in QA branch-law unitary step, which explicitly proves self-adjointness.

Complete QA branch-law verification preserves densities/weights at unitary/instrument nodes, pads early leaves, and inducts to finite terminal frontier. Ordered output and complement words index full basis; nonnegative diagonal weights sum to trace one. Finite leaf/output sum interchange normalizes law, including empty output/work.

Exact and bounded-error definitions use per-instance decision/search success events, quantum normalized branch law or classical finite-tape law. Query-cost coordinates are worst-case across promised inputs/branches and separate expected cost. Local expected-cost verification proves normalized finite prefixes, consistency, monotone query expectations, and cofinal padded round ends; no infinite history measure is assumed.

Complete reduction theorem proof preserves target promise, inducts exact query/workspace action including controlled and inverse XOR variants, transfers decision/search success via L, and sums branchwise sT costs; zero T/s cases cause no failure. Arbitrary-total search maps are compatible with permitted finite nonuniform per-length procedures; theorem asserts no uniform efficiency or computable-family generator.

Example maps are total; decision images and search witness lift check directly. Two-bit oracle returns whole u at address zero; basis-projector diagonal law has mass one on u. Exact Hadamard matrix squares to identity, giving equal output laws and gate counts 0 versus 2 with one query each; fixed reply processing is O(1).
